reason: I'd maybe poke at the free demo pet out of curiosity, but signing up for a paid plan where an AI moves my real money, through a broker partner that doesn't even exist yet, at a price nobody will tell me? No. I already do this myself in Robinhood and it works fine.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Limits and a kill switch sound nice, but I don't know who the broker is, who's on the hook if the agent screws up, or whether my account is actually protected.
would_change_my_mind: A named, regulated broker holding my account with SIPC coverage, plus a few months of the agent's demo track record that I can see actually beats what I do myself.
